analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited released its investor presentation detailing its financial results for the full-year FY2026 and Q1 FY2026-27 update. Management highlighted strong revenue growth to ₹782 Cr in FY26, a robust executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr, and an overarching phased capacity expansion plan targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29. The company also reported strong operational metrics including high capacity utilisation of 80-90%, near-zero net debt, and cash balances exceeding ₹114 Cr. Indo Tech Transformers Limited presented its FY2026 full-year results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, highlighting growth in revenue to Rs 782 Cr and PAT to Rs 93 Cr alongside an executable order book of Rs 1,318 Cr. Management outlined a phased capacity-expansion plan of Rs 495 Cr targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29 to meet rising market demand in the power and renewable sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that market demand supports capacity-led expansion.
The Indian power-transformer market is projected to grow from ₹16,063 Cr to ₹28,744 Cr from FY22 to FY30E.
